cautions.en: Task cost varies by complexity (roughly 0.5 credits for a simple change up to 1.7+ for a complex one), so the effective number of usable prompts per month is variable, not fixed.
Credits are non-refundable and expire: monthly credits after 2 months, annual grants after 1 month, top-ups after 12 months.

capabilities.en: AI software engineer that builds a web app or website from a natural-language chat
Cloud hosting included as part of the credit system, no separate hosting purchase needed
Shared workspace credits for teams, with admins able to cap monthly credit usage per member

limitations.en: Cost per task is variable and complexity-dependent, making monthly usage harder to predict than a flat seat price
Credits are non-refundable and expire on a schedule, so unused capacity is lost rather than rolled over indefinitely

reason.en: Direct AI web app builder competitor with a similar chat-to-code, live preview workflow
Competing no-code/AI app builder targeting the same non-technical and solo builder audience
